proposed_fixes.title: MWB edge-hide and return position issue remains unassigned and linked to shared MWB tracking
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Screen-edge hide/restore may use inconsistent virtual-screen coordinates between remote and local monitors, while feature state can also become stale after extended operation.
plan: Trace cursor-hide and position restoration for both endpoints and their screen bounds.
Use the correct target monitor edge and reset hide state on every transfer/activation path.
Add a two-endpoint test for primary-to-secondary and return transfer with edge hiding enabled.
verification: With hide-at-edge enabled on both PCs, transfer to the second screen and back; verify the source cursor hides and returns at the corresponding screen edge.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed primary/secondary behavior and later reports that the symptom persisted through v0.85.1. Could you confirm the current PowerToys version on both PCs, which monitor is primary on each, and whether both the missing hide and top-center return still occur? This isolates coordinate restoration from the other MWB sleep/input problems mentioned in the thread.
